title: Relative Date Input
description: Stops a date typed the way people say it from landing on the wrong day: "next Fri", "in 2 weeks", "the 15th" and "23 Oct" are read with date-fns against today, and phrases that split listeners ("next Friday" on a Wednesday, "this Monday" after Monday, "the 10th" once it has passed, "next weekend" early in the week) show both dates and wait for a pick, with a read-back and a one-tap rewrite to the unambiguous date.
stops: Next Friday lands on the wrong day
